title: Intel One Mono font (2023)
why_read: Intel One Mono is a purpose-built coding font with thoughtful design decisions, mildly interesting to developers who care about readability and typographic craft.
analysis: Intel One Mono is a monospaced typeface released by Intel specifically for code editors and terminals. It was designed with a focus on character distinctiveness to reduce reading errors in code. The font is open-source, which matters for developers who want to embed or redistribute it. The 2023 label suggests this is a re-surfacing of an older release rather than new news.
